tasks.title: Database Schema Updates and Migration

subtasks.title: Create Migration Script for Generated Code Table Updates
subtasks.description: Create SQL migration script to add file_url and file_path columns to the generated_code table with proper data types, constraints, and indexing

subtasks.title: Implement File Validation and Sanitization

Validate file names against allowed characters and length limits. Create middleware for file upload validation that checks MIME types, file extensions, and scans content for potentially harmful patterns. Implement filename sanitization to remove special characters and ensure safe storage.

subtasks.title: Create File Cleanup Mechanism with Retention Policy
